title: Four experimental Apps: pi, opencode, copilot and cursor
description:
Per the map ticket 'Apps per Stage' (harness-0sx.14, Roster, as amended: one AFK Ticket, no live checks). Research: research/agent-clis (docs/research/agent-clis.md).

Add the App table rows for pi, opencode, copilot and cursor from the research, each on every Stage: kind and binary, homepage, unattended args, model and effort arg forms (pi --thinking, copilot --effort, cursor's model suffix [effort=…]; opencode panes have none, '— opencode has no effort flag', its --variant only on a Debate side), the headless read-only side commands (pi -p --tools read,grep,find,ls; OPENCODE_PERMISSION='{"edit":"deny","bash":"deny"}' opencode run; copilot -p --deny-tool=write --deny-tool=shell; cursor agent -p --mode ask), the Delegate-skill mention form (the name in words), limit patterns and reset forms, the model-list command (pi --list-models, opencode models, cursor agent models; copilot offers default and 'type an id…'), the resume argv, and a trust reader: pi (~/.pi/agent/trust.json, nearest ancestor), cursor (~/.cursor/projects/<slug>/.workspace-trusted, an ancestor covers its children), copilot (trustedFolders in ~/.copilot/config.json, a worktree of a trusted repo is trusted); opencode has no dialog. Implement on them uses the two-step Plan (Ticket 12); the Review on pi and opencode has no sandbox, so Ticket 11's guard covers it. opencode sleeps silently through a retry-after: the Moderator's Stage timeout catches it on a Debate side; use a real bound if opencode has one. /config's Apps page and app lists mark the four 'experimental, unverified'.

The user runs only claude and codex; these rows are for other devs and ship unverified. A wrong row degrades to a Wake or a trust wait the dev can see. The result file and the PR list each App's live checks for whoever runs it: unattended launch through herdr; idle/working/blocked reading (the two-step Plan's wait, a Stage question); the trust reader; the limit text and reset; the read-only side command; the Delegate-skill mention; resume by id.

The reasoning behind each decision is on the map's closed tickets: bd show harness-0sx.<n> --json --include-comments. Research notes and prototypes live on local branches: git show research/<name>:docs/research/<file>.md, git show prototype/<name>:<path>. Vocabulary: CONTEXT.md. Decisions: docs/adr/. Rust; crates limited to serde, serde_json, regex, chrono, crossterm, ratatui and ureq, anything else needs a ticket.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests per row: the argv of a pane Stage and of a Debate side with a model and effort; the trust readers over temp HOME fixtures (trusted, an ancestor trusted, untrusted); the limit patterns match the research's sample text and not an old line; the Apps page shows 'experimental, unverified'. No live checks.
